notes.title: Patch 1.5.6 [Wizard role]
notes.notes:
[h2]New role: the wizard [/h2]

The wizard is a role for attackers (prisoners/workers).
As a wizard, the item you have in your hand will be invisible to the guards. This offers more strategy in the game and gives you a new complementary role. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/9522d540063a49382709ac025dfb15e07d691e00.png[/img]
In addition, as a wizard you float on a cloud. 


[i]Thank you all for following the adventure and sharing your experience with us. 
Your feedback helps us greatly to improve the gameplay for all future players.[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.5.1 [New Map]
notes.notes:
Patch 1.5.1 [New Map]

We thank you for the long wait, we were working a lot on the new Octotech map as well as some fixes that could affect the gameplay and its intuitiveness.


[h2]Octotech : New map[/h2] 

Our team is proud to share with you the Octotech map: a startup called Octotech that develops technological products including robots. 

In this new map, the leaders (guards) are opposed to the workers (prisoners). 
The leaders have a suit, the workers can come dressed as they wish. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/06be861491c271b2773685cf0c19090a0e19ce2a.png[/img]
You can admire the 3 floors, the stairs, the elevator that only the leaders can use. 
Be careful, the 3 floors can at first give the impression that the map is huge, but unlike Octoberak the games are faster. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/ce395ee6df4fe21a89309358133669c57b645f7e.png[/img]
During the role announcements you will have a new loading page tailored to Octotech. 



[h2]There are 5 scenarios[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/e381fa4a492a39a344c97877ab24dbc677f2bd2f.png[/img]
- Stealing works of art. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/7975df2c3928dfa49574a8c3490224426dfdd2fb.png[/img]
- Rescue workers (pick up 10 Octotech workers and release them outside).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/c49193c053413b7d7591f1e76756ba4bedaede02.png[/img]
- Build the cart and steal the gold bars from the safe. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/c70f3791b6a1c60833c55fbe00c003162ab292a2.png[/img]
- Find the evidence against the CEO and take it to the police officer outside

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/b5747e238cf65b5ddc83169bf24d9866e2b735c6.png[/img]
- Fleeing with the help of the helicopter.


[h2]Corrections[/h2] 

- Loading page before role (black page with small card)
- Player's spawn (improvement of the spawn by avoiding latency or freezes)
- Loading of assets 
- Descriptive text for each mission
- Better suggestion of stages 
- Arrow system for TP and sabotage
- Performance optimization for screens >60Hz
- TP management according to their duration

We thank all the players, especially those who report bugs, who help us to improve the gameplay, but also those who often come to play with us on the discord of the game.

Discord : https://discord.gg/dggVpgBC6n

notes.title: Patch 1.5.0 [Medium update]
notes.notes:
This patch focuses on important fixes that will improve the visual aspect of the game while also ironing out the final bugs that players may have encountered on the current map before tackling the new map.

[h2]Added two characters[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/45607c8e4fa961ea71885a3cc080b71dbaaf51f4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/4bdee442876080172639e934741fe83db8f5b0b4.png[/img]


[h2]Octocoins purchase price changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/870b731e881dd492ac5fdc1b4819284f05d84ed1.png[/img]
The number of Octocoins (when a player buys them) has been increased, so that players can afford more content while anticipating the number of cosmetics to come 


[h2]Report your problems in-game[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/3cbd9863512aeb2670c9469a25253ec90324a3f2.png[/img]
Added a ticket system (in the settings) to allow players to share their bugs more easily and help us improve the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/d685bb9ea818f4159f16f5baa1c155b704033704.png[/img]


[h2]Improved top & bottom between players[/h2]
- Players could often step on each other (feet on head when one player was too high in relation to the other), which has been corrected to make the physical reaction between players (top & down) more realistic 

[h2]Corrections[/h2]
- The arrows in the direction of prisoner work or sabotage are displayed directly on the objects concerned (added on the sabotage flames)
- Arrows for prisoner work or sabotage are no longer blocked in the right direction 
- The game parameters are no longer set by default each time the game is restarted 
- Fixed code duplication in Rescue mode
- Fixed blocking in code when assembled in Rescue mode
- Fixed streamer mode not saving when player restarts the game
- Improved the readability of the role explanation text (by moving animated elements) that appears before starting the game 
- The kick/ban button is added in the in-game settings, previously it was only available in the lobby settings
- Ranking management: all players should appear even if they have 0 points, which was not the case before
- Fixed issues with the underground, players in the underground could sometimes see players on the floor above
- The handcuff icon that appears above the prisoner's head during prisoner work no longer appears when he is invincible or imprisoned 
- Improved blocking to avoid potential unlimited skins purchases 


We would like to thank all the players, especially those who report bugs, who help us to improve the gameplay, but also those who often come to play with us on the game discord.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.9 [Medium update]
notes.notes:
In order to make the game more intuitive, we have reworked many visual points but also and especially the microphone part which should allow the players to be totally immersed in the gameplay


[h2]Lobby[/h2]

- Fixed the position of the players when you join the lobby (previously they appeared randomly on a wall, outside the room...) 
- It is now possible to switch pages with your "left" and "right" keys for champions and tricks
- It is possible to click on the dots (below the tips) to access the different slides more quickly
- When a player mutates, a red bubble with a strikethrough appears to avoid misunderstandings about microphone problems
- Improvement of the overlay of the "settings" button when they are open
- The duration of sabotage is now by default 40 seconds
- The duration of prisoner's work is now by default 55 seconds


[h2]Octobreak[/h2]

- When a player is immobilized, he cannot use his headbutt, his whistle etc... on the other players
- A counter is displayed on the whistle to understand when it is usable again
- Mission shots on target: only the balls that hit the yellow zone do not disappear from the target 
- The role of the goalkeeper is displayed on his notes
- When a player is sent to the cell, a counter is displayed above his head to know how long he will stay there
- The quality of the top/down barrels has been improved, players can now pass in front/behind
- If the prisoners' job is to go to the visiting room then now it is displayed "ALL prisoners must go to the visiting room".
- A priority system has been added to the items, especially in the prisoners' jobs, in order to drop the items more easily
- The player can no longer block himself when opening the prison board (with the scribe role)
- The opening of the carpentry and parlor boards through the wall is no longer possible 
- Scenario stealing money: the brute can now pick up the money in the safe
- Scenario explode walls: both components of the C4 are visible in one step instead of two steps to make this scenario more fluid
- Acid scenario : the barrel now disappears after making the acid
- Acid scenario : the final acid has been enlarged to make it easier to see in the hand or on the ground
- The "baton" key is gone (it was confusing) and has been replaced by the "handcuffs" key to put prisoners in cells 
- Players in the underground will no longer see the rat's tail or batons moving to the upper floor
- The arrow system for the prisoner's work is now more readable, it shows the object to work with 
- When a player picks up a code, he now sees a line on his minimap that links directly to the corresponding door 


[h2]Rescue[/h2]

- The door between the cells and the guardian zone has been improved (better collider management) 
- When players deactivate nicknames, they can see it in real time in the lobby


[h2]Fixes[/h2] 

- Microphone management and quality have been significantly improved to ensure an optimal game experience
- Code before entering the lobby: the word disappears as soon as you click on the "code" button 
- Default movement keys have been changed to Z, Q, S, D
- The volume of the fire sabotage has been lowered
- The sound setting gauge has been improved 
- Collider bank : you can stand behind the power source of the printers
- Collider balloons in the park
- Collider door that separates the cells from the guards' area

We thank all the players, especially those who report bugs, who help us to improve the gameplay, but also those who often come to play with us on the game discord.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.8 [Medium update]
notes.notes:
Over the course of the week we have made a salvo of major bug fixes. 
In addition, the game is even more accessible for beginners with visual aids. 


[h2]Beginner mode[/h2] 

- Beginner mode is enabled by default in the game settings, but it can also be disabled

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/0536f71844c64dd1e36ad6dfae0f17109cfaa414.png[/img]

- Beginner mode allows all prisoners to have scout vision, i.e. they can see the clues on the minimap: "1" and "2"
- An aura has been added around the "1" and "2" to better understand how important they are, but also to have a faster visual access 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/f8936832663e0011ec0be2909c45b01feed7dfcd.png[/img]

- Arrows appear on the screen to indicate when an important event is happening: prisoner work or sabotage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/fdd3ab4e03952a90c27b28d3bc4baafacf605173.png[/img]

- To facilitate visibility, when clicking on a door on the minimap, the key is displayed and a line connects the two
- When a player clicks on a door, the key is displayed, even if he clicks several times on the same door, the key does not disappear anymore, which was the case before


[h2]Octoberak[/h2]

- The player can block in the wall, when using the cell board (as a prisoner): was Scribe (the screen remained blocked on the board)
- Prisoners can no longer steal garbage cans 


[h2]Rescue[/h2]

- Problem head director on minimap
- Bonus problem remaining above the head and no longer allows to interact
- By clicking on "default" when rescue mode is activated, the basic settings can be reset

[h2]Lobby[/h2]

- The player no longer hears himself running endlessly when in a menu
- When entering the lobby, sometimes players could only see the nickname and shadow of others;
- When joining the lobby, sometimes players could only see the nickname and shadow of others, this has been fixed.
- When joining the lobby, players often saw others outside the lobby or on the roof, this has been fixed
- To change the page in the selection of champions or tips, the player can now use the arrows
- The spaced button used to start the game when you were the host, this is no longer the case
- The "default" button that reset the game settings only worked on the escape mode, it now also works on the rescue mode

We thank all the players, especially those who report bugs, who help us to improve the gameplay, but also those who often come to play with us on the discord of the game.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.7 [New mode update]
notes.notes:
After a Christmas break, we are back with an update that will offer you a new game mode : the "rescue" mode as well as some important fixes.

[h2]Rescue Mode[/h2]

- An each for himself game mode, players have to rescue as many prisoners as possible by depositing them on their deposit area, the first to reach the score of 10 prisoners wins. 
To increase the difficulty, players have access to bonuses (in the bonus boxes) that allow them to slow down the other players: by becoming a brute, multiplying their speed by 2, making a player small, putting down a decoy prisoner etc...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/b1ab86eb040fcbd73036079a755a63db7d193b15.png[/img]

- The mode aims to allow players who are less than 5 to still have fun in a more relaxed mode, while being able to be very competitive. 
- 1VS1 requires a lot of strategy and is very challenging. 
- There is no team rescue mode yet, but nothing prevents players from forming teams for 2VS2 (or more).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/d551e055b5b9db6d468849dca1f4fc2a31ffd27c.png[/img]

[h2]Disable nicknames & hide-and-seek[/h2]

- With the deactivation of nicknames, you can also have fun with hide and seek in the rescue mode : just deactivate nicknames in the game settings, so players can hide behind walls, trees...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313729/e29d9bbe135d54fed9823db1cdeaba5e1580d4c9.png[/img]

[h2]Graphics[/h2]

- Better management of screens with a frequency higher than 60 Hz
- Better management of screen sizes (up to 3840 x 2160)

[h2]Corrections[/h2]

- Fixed the "Steal the money" scenario, players could no longer access the safe because of the new rat role.

We thank all the players, especially those who report bugs, who help us to improve the gameplay, but also those who often come to play with us on discord. 

Wishing you a very nice year 2022.

Discord : [url=https://discord.gg/aqaK7cr]Discord[/url]
Twitter : [url=https://twitter.com/Octofightmobile]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.6 [Medium update]
notes.notes:
For this new update, we have a lot of corrections, optimization of the game (comprehensibility, intuitiveness, fun) and a consequent addition of content (new characters and skins).

[h2]New characters[/h2] 

- 1 Octocoin (x4 skins) : Prisoner, Mask, Green stars, Red Knight
- Keenka (x4 skins) : Prisoner, Gold hole, Green stars, Red Knight
- Samourai (x4 skins) : Prisoner, Club, Gold hole, Green stars
- Vegan Paul (x4 skins) : Prisoner, Mask, Green stars, Red Knight

[h2]Added skins[/h2] 

- Andrea (x4 skins) : Gold hole, Green stars, Smiley, Fruits
- Showby (x3 skins) : Gold hole, Green stars, Red Knight
- Warlyx (x3 skins) : Gold hole, Green stars, Red Knight

[h2]New roles[/h2] 

In order to improve the balance guard VS prisoner, to increase the team cohesion, or divergences, we have added two new roles: 

1 - Rat: The rat is a role for prisoners or guards, he sees Octocoins on the map and can collect them.  If his team wins, the Octocoins collected on the map will be doubled, otherwise he will only win what he has collected.
2 - Scribe : The scribe is only for prisoners, as soon as he assembles a code, it will be automatically written on the corresponding door on his minimap and that of his teammates.

[h2]Emotes[/h2] 

- 8 new emotes (wand, easy, go go go, ha ha ha, cry, laugh, thumbs up, thumbs down) 

[h2]Gameplay[/h2] 

- Added "push to talk" (management in controls)
- Added the possibility to activate or deactivate the proximity text chat (managed in the controls) 
- The parlor area is displayed when players have to go there in the prisoner's work
- All objects that can be seen on the minimap, can also be tracked when a player moves with it (if an ally moves with a card in his hand, you will see it move with him)
- The explanations on the "Top secret" notes have been reworked to better indicate the escape routes for the players

[h2]Lobby[/h2] 

- Automated role management when a new player enters the lobby 
- If a role is missing in the game settings, it is shown in red to target the problem more easily

[h2]Animations[/h2] 

- Animation of the ranking trophy at the end of the game 
- Improved animation when a player enters or leaves the underground 

[h2]UI[/h2] 

- All players appear in the ranking (except those with 0 points) 

[h2]Two new languages[/h2] 

- Added Turkish language 
- Added Thai language

[h2]Corrections[/h2]

- Language detection, your game will automatically switch to your language for a better user experience
- The "God mode" issue is fixed, players will no longer find themselves going through walls. 
- Optimized map loading management to avoid seeing blue tiles when the player exits or enters the underground, or if the game is in x2 speed
- Improved door opening for prisoners when a guard has left his door open (red LED), the prisoner can open the door (green LED) from the inside or the outside
- Guards and prisoners can't hear each other at the beginning of the game, or even during the whole game (problem where prisoners or guards could hear each other on the whole map during at least 1 minute of non-lobby game).
- The earth that you have to dig in the underground (scenario: dig under the carpentry) is no longer visible from the machinery but only in the underground

Thank you all for following us and helping us to improve the game.
We learn from all your feedback and use it to provide the best possible game experience.

Global Discord Community: [url=https://discord.gg/GvxDteCGtD]Discord here[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/Octofightmobile]Click here[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.3 [Medium Update]
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Gameplay[/h2][/b] 
We have added two new roles to bring even more dynamism and strategy to the game.

1 - Bully : Bully is only for prisoners, this role can hit guards to immobilize them. 
As long as the bully's punch is available and not used, the guards will not be able to put the bully in the cell. 
2 - Slacker : The slacker is only for the guards, as a slacker, he only has half of the missions to do. 
He can use this time to watch the prisoners more intensively. 

[b][h2]Rankings[/h2][/b]
To increase competitiveness and allow players to acquire Octocoins for free: we have created a ranking system. 

At the end of the game, players can click on the top right corner of the screen to see who has been the most successful during the game. 

[b][h2]Corrective part[/h2][/b]
- Your steam name will be the last one you updated (yes, many people ended up with the name they created as a child)
- Mouse scroll can be used normally when there is a scroll system in the menu/settings
- The microphone registers correctly, it doesn't open again by default when you restart the game
- There is no more double loading at the beginning of the game (after launching from the lobby)
- We have optimized the loading of assets, which means that players no longer have a load when they go underground
- Players can no longer spam the key to go underground

notes.title: Game release: Octofight Escape
notes.notes:
After a year of development, the beta version Octofight Escape is finally available on Steam. 

First of all, you should know that we are a team of 3 people, who after having developed a mobile game "Octofight", we have created a new game: multiplayer, multi-team, on pc and soon smartphone (crossplatform).

We are really happy to share this game with you, a game in which you have to learn to play strategically, while adapting to the role and the team you will be in. 
The "Escape game" part is what we think was missing in many social multiplayer games, so we hope you will like it the way we built it!  

During the different prototypes, many of you have helped us to fix annoying bugs, to improve the gameplay to make it more intuitive and we thank you very much. 

We want to make sure that all players will have the best gaming experience, so don't hesitate to follow us on our different networks to be informed of our news but also and especially to exchange directly with us. 

The game being still in beta, many updates are already planned with new content that we are eager to share with you ...

A big thank you in advance to all those who will support us by taking the game. 

Wishing you all the best on Octofight Escape! 

Octofight Escape development team.
